title: Martingale
source_text: You are playing a game called _Martingale_. The rules of the game are as follows: 1. At the beginning of the game, you are given $N$ as input. 2. Set $V = N$, and set $X = 1$. 3. Flip a fair coin. - If the coin lands on heads: Increase $V$ by $X$, and then set $X = 1$. - If the coin lands on tails: Decrease $V$ by $X$, and then set $X = 2X$. 4. If $V \leq 0$ or $V \geq 2N$: - End the game. 5. Proceed to step 3. Given the initial value $N$, what is the expected number of turns (coin flips) you will play before ending the game? Input Input consists of a single integer, $N$ (with $1 \leq N \leq 1,000,000$), the initial input to the game. Output A single decimal number, containing the expected number of turns you will play this game before it ends. Your output will be accepted if it is within $10^{-6}$ absolute or relative error. Constraints - $1 \leq N \leq 1,000,000$ Sample Input 1 Sample Output 1.000000000000 Sample Input 3 Sample Output 3.9609375
